title: [Media Coverage] Why Japan Digs into Basic Research at Its National AI Institute - Ten Years of RIKEN AIP and Building a Bridge of Collaboration with Korea (ZDNet Korea, September 18, 2026)
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: An article by Center Director Masashi Sugiyama was published in ZDNet Korea under the title “Why Japan Digs into Basic Research at Its National AI Institute – Ten Years of RIKEN AIP and Building a Bridge of Collaboration with Korea.” AIP advances research on the theoretical foundations of machine learning and trustworthy AI, while also promoting international collaboration and talent development in AI research.
